stories.title: 3M Open Final Round — Jackson Koivun's -20 Chase

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Jackson Koivun just shot 61 in Round 3 of the 3M Open.

Back-nine 28 — a tournament record.
Eagles on 12 AND 18.

He's 21 years old and leads at -20.

Three shots clear entering Sunday. 🏌️ #3MOpen #PGATour

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Final round at TPC Twin Cities.

Koivun at -20 (led by 3).
Scheffler lurking at -14.
Michael Kim's 59 story from Thursday feels like a week ago.

A 21-year-old who shot a tournament-record 28 on the back nine is now chasing his first Tour win. #3MOpen #PGATour

Led every single round.

Through the back nine of the final round: -20, four-shot lead.

DeChambeau chasing. Hatton third.

Herbert is doing what wire-to-wire looks like. #LIVGolf #LIVGolfUK

Wire-to-wire at JCB Golf & Country Club.

Ripper GC dominant in the team standings too.

One of LIV's most complete performances of the season. #LIVGolf

Back-to-back titles at Dundonald Links for England's Woad. 🏆 #WomensScottishOpen #LPGA

stories.title: Ryan Fox — The Champion Who Started 85th

x_posts.label: Post 5-1
x_posts.text:
Ryan Fox's Open Championship stat line:

R1: tied 85th.
R2: tied 52nd.
R3: 62.
R4: 68.

Final 36 holes matched the Open record.

Champion at -10. Beat Cameron Young by one.

From New Zealand. "I used to get up in the night to watch this." #TheOpen #OpenChampionship

x_posts.label: Post 5-2
x_posts.text:
The 2026 Open Champion was tied for 85th after Round 1.

Ryan Fox shot 62-68 in the final 36 holes — matching the all-time Open record.

Winning margin: one shot over Cameron Young.

The Claret Jug goes to New Zealand. 🏆 #TheOpen #RyanFox
